lines.narration: The largest animal ever recorded is no dinosaur. It's alive right now.
The blue whale tops two hundred tonnes — thirty-three elephants in one body.
It grows as long as three school buses.
Its tongue alone weighs as much as an elephant.
Its heart weighs four hundred pounds — three grown men.
The artery leaving it is wide enough for a newborn to crawl through.
A calf is born weighing two and a half tonnes.
Then it gains ninety kilograms a day, on milk alone.
But the biggest animal on Earth eats one of the smallest.
Four tonnes of krill a day — each one smaller than your thumb.
No teeth — it lunges, and strains the swarm through baleen.
The dinosaurs never held the record. The champion is out there right now.
